method: SMT mathematical interval enclosure composed with actual production Rust bridges
qualification_rule: All listed obligations and controls must have source-bound successful receipts and independently reviewed composition. An SMT UNSAT result alone does not qualify native execution; no Kani C2 PASS is implied.

interpretation.native_value: The exact signed mathematical integer denoted by the retained Rust i128 payload. No custom MathematicalInteger decoder is required for the direct wide bridges.
interpretation.signed32_embedding: Rust i32 -> i128 widening preserves the signed integer. Every actual admitted public i128 payload must losslessly roundtrip through i32.
interpretation.wide_product: Rust i128::checked_mul returning Some denotes exact signed mathematical multiplication without overflow. Its signed64 roundtrip is separately asserted.
interpretation.order: Rust primitive signed i128 comparison denotes the order of these exact mathematical signed integers. The actual NativeIntegerInterval method is machine-bound to this predicate.
interpretation.real_embedding: SMT-LIB to_real embeds mathematical Int into Real. The embedding query checks product, order, min and max preservation without bounds or assumed identities.
interpretation.semantic_bounds: Independent optional signed-i128 semantic result bounds do not narrow operand intervals, payloads, or the numerical capacity theorem.

composition: Actual plan admission establishes original operand interval membership; the signed32 roundtrip bridge establishes that the universal signed32 product theorem applies to every actual admitted i128 payload.

The actual per-plan calculation equals the universal full-domain production calculation, which the direct wide bridge identifies with the exact mathematical signed product x*y, with no overflow and no promotion.
The wide corner bridge identifies the actual checked plan endpoints with the exact min/max of a*c,a*d,b*c,b*d for the original complete intervals.

Lossless integer-to-real embedding transfers exact endpoint order, payload membership and products to the universally checked real theorem; no native width, sign case or sampled interval narrows that theorem.
UNSAT of a product below all four corners or above all four corners implies min(corners)<=x*y<=max(corners). Embedding order preservation returns these inequalities to signed mathematical Int.
The direct contains bridge maps these exact signed inequalities back to the actual production capacity.contains(result), closing the no-false-capacity-breach obligation by explicit composition.

protocol_controls.healthy: UNSAT of the exact negated unbounded Real enclosure statement; schema rejects extra premises or omitted endpoints.
protocol_controls.positive: SAT base nonvacuity, all nine interval-sign cases, full signed32 MIN squared / negative extreme / zero witnesses. Returned exact rational models must be integral signed32 values and satisfy independently calculated premises, products and four-corner image.
protocol_controls.mutants: Weakened upper image omits b*d; Add replaces payload product; missing lower membership premise. Each must produce an actual SAT countermodel independently validated against the mutated and original statements.
protocol_controls.contradictions: Contradictory membership and contradictory sign predicates must be UNSAT as negative controls; these controls cannot supply a theorem or qualification result.
protocol_controls.scope: Only SAT controls search the full original signed32 integer population. The healthy enclosure and Int-to-Real embedding theorems remain unbounded.
protocol_controls.classification: Unknown, timeout, compile/tool error, malformed result/model, missing control or bridge is inconclusive. The script never reports native qualification or Kani C2 verification.

consumer_boundary: Genuine TC-025/TC-027/IR-917/IR-948 production profiles retain their original inputs, domains, assertions, covers, Cadical and resource settings. This internal proof method does not replace those runs.
